scope: H200, same checkpoint/engines and original kernels, loaded inputs. 11 alternating repeats. B1 first12individual requests; B3/B8whole73English/12Japanese corpus batches, not singleton latency. Separate enqueue diagnostic includes timer overhead and driver waits. Original single graphs retained. Cold incremental memory includes graph/private pools; all variant pools resident, not standalone deployment peak. Default B1 beam chunk1 is unchanged control.

gpu_allocation_samples.scope: Entire sampled allocation: includes load/JIT/capture/diagnostics/idle and all resident variant pools. Five-second utilization snapshots are not a per-variant steady-state metric or kernel wall time.

decision: Do not adopt broadly:1B changes mostly within unchanged-control noise;102M B3/B8 regress.102M translationB1 gains1.566%/0.655% require independent replication and isolated memory/cold assessment before any adoption; lower priority than measured decoder work. No public API/default/runtime changes.

failed_predecessor.failure: CUDA stream capture invalidated during later reference GreedySession construction; graph reset not permitted during capture warnings
failed_predecessor.defect: Experiment stores bound _run and fallback methods on same session: reference cycle delays graph destruction until cyclic GC.
failed_predecessor.causality: Cycle is directly established; its responsibility for GPU failure requires full rerun. No runtime defaults modified.
